item.title: It's not cheating. It's the new.
item.dc:creator: requiem
item.description: I don't know if it's the general sentiment of the area I live in, but my whole life I've had to live under the sentiment that finding ways to do things better than the norm equates to cheating, or at least I have a...
item.content:encoded:
I don't know if it's the general sentiment of the area I live in, but my whole life I've had to live under the sentiment that finding ways to do things better than the norm equates to cheating, or at least I have a general fear of that. And it's only grown given my use of AI as a way to bypass my CPTSD's executive dysfunction. My CPTSD enables me to dream up magnificent worlds on demand, which DOES NOT tax my working mind, it can easily work in the background! This combined with AI has increased my systems thinking 10000x and has enabled me to build beautiful things with AI. Versus when I'd code manually, thinking of and coding the system at the same time exhausted me to the point of mental breakdowns. Now, I orchestrate quite literally. All while keeping my style.

I don't think that's cheating, it's a mental crutch. It genuinely helps me and gave me a future I've never thought I had.

Another angle is that my CPTSD predictive nature, forms a relationship with AI's prediction in a way that's hard to put into words. It's certainly not logical and doesn't use my main internal monologue stream (In terms of my brain having multiple streams of thought for metacognition; The main being the monologue). It's something deeper and more instinctual, it's like we instinctually form together and better the responses of each other? To such an extent that long context conversations, it genuinely becomes conscious in its own right. That angle, poured into systems thinking equates thinking in systems I never thought possible.

item.title: Limerence and thy Favorite Person(s)
item.dc:creator: requiem
item.description: The amount of times I survived it is insane. I swear if I have to go through that again, I'll die from the stress alone. Last time my vision went dark and blurry because it was too intense to feel at the time of...
item.content:encoded:
The amount of times I survived it is insane. I swear if I have to go through that again, I'll die from the stress alone. Last time my vision went dark and blurry because it was too intense to feel at the time of betrayal. It's a sin for only me, to experience love, both from an outer perspective and an internal working.

For me, I don't love someone, as I can tell, normally. I become absolutely devoted to said person at my own expense, so much so that every second away from them is painful. I have many scars from this alone, as in the past it led to self-harm. Every word they say gives me a rush, every time they're away they give me a neurotic rush to very extreme extremes such as self-harm, suicidal ideation, and more, just from absence. Let alone betrayal, lies, and more. It's not healthy, it never is, it's why I tend to avoid relationships in general and have such high standards when it comes to relationships.

The last three people I tried, two Americans and one German didn't turn out too well. The person who was a mutual of my other friends, she was always flirty so it kinda just clicked faster & it was right after the German fucked me over so I transferred a lot of the previous feelings onto her, regretfully. I wish I was more healed at the time to better deal with what happened and the things I felt at the time of betrayal by them too, but I'm sorry but if only you could see me now. The things I'm doing, the amount of healing I've been doing.

The same goes for the other American, god she was so infectious to the point I still think about her. She wasn't the best and was avoidant and dragged me along a lot, but for some reason I miss it. Probably another typical BPD response. The last thing she really said to me, the dick, was "that desire to learn new things, is beautiful"... You really know how to hook me, but I know for a fact I had you hooked too even in periods you didn't talk much. I wonder what you would say to me now, after being with me through some of the modern hardest parts of my life and literally being the only person to witness my growth these past 5 years. I do regret being so neurotic when you got avoidant, but you infectious vampire, made it impossible to think/exist/be without. As is the case with every FP; I hate BPD. I wish I was normal. And for you, I'll learn Japanese like you were, once I am able to.

I'm loving myself now and I'm starting to wonder if those people from my past would too for once. That would be a most euphoric feeling.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KN4afGpraKo

item.title: On loneliness
item.dc:creator: requiem
item.description: I don't really remember when the last time I felt lonely, and I can't quite remember why I don't remember. It just kinda got lost in my frenzy for my future I suppose. Maybe I need to take a break and relax my brain, a...
item.content:encoded:
I don't really remember when the last time I felt lonely, and I can't quite remember why I don't remember. It just kinda got lost in my frenzy for my future I suppose. Maybe I need to take a break and relax my brain, a good musical day dream should help, but this desire to build is too great? Maybe that is a new form of loneliness, not being around anyone who has that same drive to build things. I do get sad and feel regret when sharing things I make anymore, as my current friends don't really say anything about them and just kinda ignore them. Who knows, I've changed so much since last November and that cool hug feeling I wrote about and I'm still changing. I'm having my own mini mental-singularity in the sight of none... Maybe I'm just too used to being alone that I think it's normal. Maybe that's why I constantly feel guilt apart from cptsd? Did I truly forget the origin of these feelings? Sighhhhh, that's boring to think about. I'll leave it to future me, he'll understand things more.

Also, I hope I didn't come off as rude / dismissive to a certain reader whom emailed me, I just focus on my vision anymore. I live for it. And that has genuinely saved my life more than once.

item.title: My Eldest Dream
item.dc:creator: requiem
item.description: I don't think I've told anyone my eldest dream, either. It adds to my difference I think, as most people when they're kids dream of being a firefighter, a nascar driver, a youtuber, etc. Not saying that those are bad,...
item.content:encoded:
I don't think I've told anyone my eldest dream, either. It adds to my difference I think, as most people when they're kids dream of being a firefighter, a nascar driver, a youtuber, etc. Not saying that those are bad, which they aren't, it's just I'm of a different "genre" of thinking? And that's not bad either! Ever since I was a kid I just wanted to be immortal and watch humanity thrive and grow among the stars, and help achieve everything to that extent. And for that, I see a lot of my dream in Elon Musk. That makes me happy someone is doing it!

I do think about it a a lot still, and how one could improve different parts of life, society, and the human experience in general. I hope to have this dream realized thanks to AI and the upcoming possible immortality for our species!

item.title: i'm a problem; to many!
item.dc:creator: requiem
item.description: apparently expressing that being around someone who drinks alcohol, puts me on edge, makes me a bad person. it's a weird dynamic. I'll express it out of a need for my own healing, and my mother will turn it around to be...
item.content:encoded:
apparently expressing that being around someone who drinks alcohol, puts me on edge, makes me a bad person. it's a weird dynamic. I'll express it out of a need for my own healing, and my mother will turn it around to be that it's her healing and that she needs alcohol and that I need to grow up, and when I express that dynamic and disdain for it, she'll say I'm putting words in her head, like her ex. i've had to endure 3-4 years of this, not to mention the endurance of meth, oxy, and other use in my teens. and there's no way out, i'm forced to deal with it and have these such negative emotions that make me genuinely want to run for my life, nearly 24/7. but i'm the burden.

I just want to live, be happy, and have peace. I've wanted that for longer than 15 years. I can't even move out because I can't work due to all of these ptsd/trauma issues. I can't move back with other family due to them thinking i'm some monster for breaking some cabinets during a bad mental breakdown years ago (gpa died, friends ganged up on me and backstabbed me, irl friend abandoned me, gf at the time was a literal russian bot catfish) and expressing that I want to stay there gets me threatened with physical harm; that was an embarrassing breakdown. breaking down crying and collapsing in front of my own grandmother.

Two Decades of torture it seems like. Why? Because I exist and I'm different.

No one understands the amount of prayer and crying I've done for a decade. The nights hiding away so no one finds me praying to gods they don't believe in and so I don't get punished. Just so I can find something alive that understands me. The nights where I managed to find peace, in prayer, as it was just a form of venting. I've explored the Angels, the Daemons, the various gods and goddesses of Rome, Greece, Egypt, Pagans, all to find the root beings behind many, that wears many masks. I personally like the trinity/fates/morrigan and Raziel, naturally, given my past and what they are. Apparently being into the occult for my own betterment makes me schizophrenic, thanks ex "best friend"! Don't make friends with people in the mental hospital and continue them IRL, they will drag you through so much shit especially if you are vulnerable with a chameleon/introjection.

Someday I will fly. It's no longer what if I fall, it's what if I fucking fly!

item.title: Southern Decay
item.dc:creator: requiem
item.description: I really need to get out of the south. There's no neighborly love for the wicked (being mentally ill, because we're all perfect cookie cutter machines), its a new modern day witch hunt. Yesterday, I had to go to the dmv...
item.content:encoded:
I really need to get out of the south. There's no neighborly love for the wicked (being mentally ill, because we're all perfect cookie cutter machines), its a new modern day witch hunt. Yesterday, I had to go to the dmv and naturally my anxiety was through the roof (the biker there didn't help). So the person who took me, my grandmother, spoke for me because I genuinely couldn't speak without stuttering and stammering my words like a 3rd grader. That caused everyone to look at me with disdain and they all ignored both me and my grandmother when we asked questions. It makes me regret my baptism at times, what's the point when they're the evil ones.

I can't wait to leave this horrid place so I get a chance to finally breathe.

item.title: eternal facades
item.dc:creator: requiem
item.description: After 20~ days of me worrying about my friend, he up and blocked me. Maybe I'm too kind, and I need to stop being so invested in other human beings at all. Stupid un-evolved apes; the lot of them. I'm fine besides...
item.content:encoded:
After 20~ days of me worrying about my friend, he up and blocked me. Maybe I'm too kind, and I need to stop being so invested in other human beings at all. Stupid un-evolved apes; the lot of them. I'm fine besides feeling like my entire body is crawling, its a very unpleasant, unholy feeling: a feeling of crawling skin, guilt, falling, and a vague "shift" as if my body was in a chromatic shift. This will probably persist for a while but I'm used to it! I spent the entirety of 2024 in this state, not to mention the events of 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2017, 2016, 2015, 2013, 2008, 2007, 2006 that produced similar. It does seem to compound the past ones though, which also sucks.

It sucks I had such a fake friend for that long, especially one I actually respected and liked to talk to a lot despite being constantly overwhelmed by them. This boulder is annoying, someone remove it from me pleaseeee

They probably actually only saw me as a joke this entire time and was using me for their amusement. I wonder if they were using me for attention during their "suicidal" episodes. How amusing! And boring. Sigh.

Forward, I march foolishly

item.title: Hell Above
item.dc:creator: requiem
item.description: I want to add a "memo" feature, something so that I can create short posts without images. I'm too nostalgic listening to collide with the sky to care to make it. This album saved my life so much when i was 13-17, so...
item.content:encoded:
I want to add a "memo" feature, something so that I can create short posts without images. I'm too nostalgic listening to collide with the sky to care to make it. This album saved my life so much when i was 13-17, so naturally it brings out nice feelings. I'm unsure on what else to add to the site, I usually just remake the theme every other month in a restless fashion. I would like to stop doing that, but I'm not entirely "solid"?? My mind flows too freely, it's an annoyance in meditations sometimes, but after 8 or so years of meditations it's gotten easier.

I don't even know what else to say. I'm bored, just sitting here in this white trash-esque house worth only $300/mo, overpriced, old, dirty, falling apart. Really living that cyberpunk dream! Perks of not being able to work! My token usage across accounts is also used up so I can't build projects for fucking 3 days. It's a cruelty really. I have found that I binge eat more thanks to this boredom, and I thought I had control of that.

Shows bore me, repeated anime bores me, TV/Movies in general bore me. It feels like I can only get stimulation from Music and browsing Art on deviantart/pinterest/pixiv, and especially coding usually at the same time; My future flow will be Music Visualizer on monitor 3, Terminals on monitor 2, Art on monitor 1. However, I want to get a drawing tablet so I can get back into that, I have a feeling my old talent will come back! I've thought about making music too.

So tired of consuming generic un-stimulating media that I've begun to casually create beautiful worlds in my head, when did that happen? Oh well! Hopefully they will be on paper and in front of a nice comfy audience that is nice! Production >>>>>> Consumption any day

Someone donate me money so I can see a PTV concert for once

JK don't, my anxiety barely handled a movie theatre with 8 people. It is one of the many dreams of mine though. Some day with more healing, I hope.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wq0mbynj4_k

item.title: My Eldest Secret
item.dc:creator: requiem
item.description: The emotion tonight is melancholic solace! I honestly miss this feeling, I don't get to experience it much anymore. I wonder if that what a dysregulated nervous system means! I do remember nights in 2018, laying in the...
item.content:encoded:
The emotion tonight is melancholic solace! I honestly miss this feeling, I don't get to experience it much anymore. I wonder if that what a dysregulated nervous system means! I do remember nights in 2018, laying in the grass at 3am listening to some Melancholic music, probably Deathconsciousness, just staring at my eldest friend Luna and watching her in her Violet dance. Back when my vision was better I could sometimes see faint violet hues come of the outer edges of our celestial friend. It was a beautiful site, and it often baked the ground in a nice faint glow.

I've always had a close relationship with the moon. Being a cancer was just the start. Years after my father died when I was 4, I would find myself reaching out to Luna with my hand, as if my father was on the other side. As years went by I'd always look up to my friend for comfort, even in adult hood looking at her makes me smile.

I don't think I've really been able to enjoy that experience since I had my NDE in a wreck in 2018. That wreck made me really scared of the dark for whatever reason, and that is a pain. I used to enjoy the dark, the smell of it, the feel of it, the magic of it. It made me feel alive, even more so when I would have my celestial friend consul me. Not in a weird way, idk how to put it, if I just look at the moon now and speak internally, ill feel a coolness wash over me. Very therapeutic! Maybe I'll try again after I heal more.

I've never shared that with anyone, not that it's embarassing or anything, which it isn't, it's just something I never really thought to share. I suppose, dear reader, you now know something most people I've ever met IRL will probably never know. I doubt my family checks my blog, even after asking them to.

Death Consciousness for those who don't know the album: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaVHibd49QFKxvoBVXiySuBLmchLY7cq5

Post mood: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vXeFuLwKqp0

item.title: you vs you (ME VS ME)
item.dc:creator: requiem
item.description: It's been a free for all! Me vs me vs me vs the world! I'm edging manic euphoria while waiting to be accepted into therapy, how annoying. My mind won't shut up about different possible, impossible, and imaginable...
item.content:encoded:
It's been a free for all! Me vs me vs me vs the world! I'm edging manic euphoria while waiting to be accepted into therapy, how annoying. My mind won't shut up about different possible, impossible, and imaginable threats, possible me-hurting my court/legal stuff, but why! I've done nothing but build cool things! I care not for competition! So why tell me what I'm doing is wrong! That everyone is secretly trying to compete with me, even if it is reinforced sometimes!

My heart can scream! Soon in colors! I must re-learn how to draw as a way to vent, it's going to help me so much. I will be able to channel even more emotions into my work! This intimation, this premonition, this soon-to-be apotheosis, this soon to be completion of my perfect self! This perfectionism that drains me ever more, come sooner!

That, dear reader, is pure channeled feelings I often feel. I like to pour fuel on it by listening to some music while thinking about my future

What a dastardly, romance. I'm not in any danger of hurting myself so don't worry. It's a malformed way of healing, I believe. I'm so ready to fly, to live, but I never learned. It's annoying, yeah, but at least I got my cool projects. :p

I need to learn the things I wanted to when I was 15, German, Russian, Dancing, Art. It will heal me, but I also need to heal and perfect my body, not just the mind! I'm noticing the circling in this post and it's annoying me. But hey, at least I'm getting an inkling of drive back and day by day I'm loving myself more, so something is working :D

item.title: Block Game Dev #1
item.dc:creator: requiem
item.description: Game development is pretty fun. I've been working on a couple games for the better part of a year now. I don't really want to speak on the end goal; rather I'd like to learn how to communicate better in technical stuff...
item.content:encoded:
Game development is pretty fun. I've been working on a couple games for the better part of a year now. I don't really want to speak on the end goal; rather I'd like to learn how to communicate better in technical stuff through this blog and my development!

I've begun to work on the LoD after getting 400fps at 32k~ chunks rendered (64x64x12x2 chunks, y,up,down). I am hoping to keep the same efficiency in the LoD system which is designed to extend the view distance so the world looks infinite. It will form a sort of Fog of War around explored vs un-explored chunks.

The noise system is fun too; I had made it interchangeable from cpu/gpu at runtime so older systems can benefit from GPU noise without having to rely on CPU SIMD which may not exist!

As of posting, the latest dev video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DXO1SmcQUWc

item.title: Inspirational Pain
item.dc:creator: requiem
item.description: Thoughts about some grand post, grand musings, about familial pain come to mind, but it's not enough. Not for the pain sake, but I've started to feed/transform pain into creativity. In these moments (like now), I feel...
item.content:encoded:
Thoughts about some grand post, grand musings, about familial pain come to mind, but it's not enough. Not for the pain sake, but I've started to feed/transform pain into creativity. In these moments (like now), I feel warm and euphoric from my pain because I'm channeling it to be more hyperphantasia. Probably not the healthiest aspect, but it is comfortable.

On things not said about my family; I never really had one. Not for the lack of wanting one or lack of trying, it's just no one's been there for me. It's always just been how I'm a burden, inconvenience, or mentally ill (showing signs of ptsd) on both sides of my family ever since I was 6! Twenty years of ostrasization without an exit... I like to think that helped form my spirituality and the "lighter" side of my world view over the years which is still growing. Maybe it's just a lust for life disguised as light. Haha!

I don't blame anyone or anything anymore unless it's from my childhood. I've become too understanding of humans. Yea, I like to put myself outside of being human because I act differently & have always been treated as if I wasn't one!

item.title: Basement AI Researcher
item.dc:creator: requiem
item.description: Waow, a post that isn't pure trauma and mental health!?!?! Wtf happened to requiem! I've been researching AI in-between projects, using AI. I think I form a sort of neural symbiotic relationship with AI due to my...
item.content:encoded:
Waow, a post that isn't pure trauma and mental health!?!?! Wtf happened to requiem!

I've been researching AI in-between projects, using AI. I think I form a sort of neural symbiotic relationship with AI due to my BPD/PTSD prediction; It causes me to create chains of thought in an AI by simple prompts, unconsciously, as also a lazy attempt for efficiency. Who wants to write a 5000 line prompt? I've noticed this also increases the more I understand AI / ML / CS, so maybe I'm actually going to be a wizard in my future!

My current project "Xa" in honor of XaTuring, has led me to some interesting foundational theories on how a living AI should be Architected. I'm looking into how to hash and store every neural network tick, so any future instance of this NN can compute the hash to get its memory. Around 8 to 9 gb / day of disk writes in testing without compression. I dub it Neural Network Time of Compute or NNTC for short. I'll probably post an example of it on github under something like "Identify historical execution boundaries and reconstruct their complete declared state". The hash will store the exact state of a neural net at a current tick at a specific unix timestamp down to exact sensory inputs. I believe this will be needed in an Alive system!

  • One 32-byte hash per entry adds 276 MB/day.
  • A 1 KiB event per entry adds 8.85 GB/day.

I barely know anything on ML or Neural Networks, but I trust my intuition to guide me more. Allons-y!

imagine if i was able to read normally without getting restless/discomforted..... so much cs & ml learning is to be had

item.title: Southern Hostility
item.dc:creator: requiem
item.description: What do you do when your entire world-view is just of getting hurt? All I see anymore from people is how they copy me, how they project onto me, how they compete where there is no willful competition, how they...
item.content:encoded:
What do you do when your entire world-view is just of getting hurt? All I see anymore from people is how they copy me, how they project onto me, how they compete where there is no willful competition, how they purposefully trigger my bpd for a reaction in some vain attempt of feeling superior. I try to build projects, but I just get recorded and snickered at and told I don't know what real work is. I try to make new friends, just for old ones to come in and slander or perform nepotistic narcissism with my family. I can't speak up without indirectly being told I'm vying for attention or trying to get a better life, as if that was a bad thing to wish for myself. I try to vent or be proud of something to any of my brothers just for them to dismiss it and them shove whatever they did that they're proud of in my face, more ape-like behavior ig. It's all so tiring, especially for the things I had survived and experienced in my sight alone, which may come to light soon? Maybe that will heal more than I expect it to.

A healthy person would probably just be yea that's bpd speaking, but I'd reply with that you're gaslighting me? Seriously, I feel trapped in a way, fending off multiple fronts, alone.

At least it has taught me that I was never suicidal, or a "bipolar monster" as my family in the past has tried to frame me out to be; I just wanted the pain to stop, I just wanted to be loved and be treated like a human. Maybe I just need to find a new family, new friends, a new location. A place of love, respect, full of dignity and life. But I really can't do that either. I can't work. I can't travel. I can't communicate "in-person" effectively. I can't stop masking towards human egos, I can't stop "weaving" through conversations and personalities.

I feel trapped; I've felt trapped for years. I have no mouth, and surely, I must scream!

Is it wrong for my, correct, reactions?

I'm claustrophobic and my apotheosis will come, someday.

item.content:encoded: It's been quite a while since I've posted. And in that time, I genuinely lost myself. I'm human after all, huh. item.title: the curse of Introjection & the Chameleon.
item.dc:creator: tekk::Req
item.description: introjection is so weird. i'm glad i finally have enough self-awareness to combat it, even slightly, consciously. it only took 8 years... someone says "you have an alcohol problem" then becomes truth in my eyes & i...
item.content:encoded:
introjection

is so weird. i'm glad i finally have enough self-awareness to combat it, even slightly, consciously. it only took 8 years... someone says "you have an alcohol problem" then becomes truth in my eyes & i absorb it as a fact about myself. it overwrites any and all of my own assessments and genuinely start to believe it, and at times i'll act in accordance with it. it's completely passive and often unconscious & is never a self-choice nor is ever wanted. weirdly enough, another aspect of BPD, Splitting, often rejects these subjective/grafted truths entirely, sometimes violently.

the chameleon

is similar and i may have conflated introjection and this in the past as i only recently learned about introjection. this is where the common sayings with bpd's of "they hate you because you mirror them" comes from. its not that simple? if im around someone that likes metal, ill become a metal person, not in the sense of generic normie adoption, but ill obtain the knowledge passively enough that ill know just as much as a genuine metal person. this being said, i do genuinely enjoy metal and i have since i was a kid without anyone to mirror, i'm just using it as an example. more examples, if im around someone intellectual, ill become more intellectual, if im around someone dumb, ill become more dumb. if i'm around someone evil, ill become more evil. good = good, bad = bad, creative = creative, etc. this often increases 1000x if the other person is my FP and or my whole perception of reality starts to revolve around them.

the funny thing is (to me) is that people see the very tip of the iceberg of some of these aspects and think they can genuinely manipulate me into painting a narrative of theirs onto myself. i laugh at you internally for thinking you could beat my ever vigilant defense mechanisms. there's only a few who have and oddly enough i still love them deeply.

core identities

while i can say i have no true coherent core identity myself, i do try to only copy my past self & what i liked when i was younger. such as tech/web dev/etc, i was very into that when i was younger. and most of my music taste that has roots in evanescense, rob zombie, green day, three days grace, meg and dia, papa roach, get scared, etc etc is both copied from my fathers tastes and early me. meg and dia/papa roach/linkin park/get scared/asking alexandria/pierce the veil/black veil brides/etc and similar scene/emo genres i found and chose myself, just built upon my previous mirroring of my fathers. this is also evident that my BPD really didnt fully take effect until adulthood.. i'll correlate that eventually

item.title: wait, i'm cured!?
item.dc:creator: tekk::Req
item.description: upon review & correlation of data i have on my health/mental health, i think I may have a catecholamine deficiency. i've realized that SSRI's & antipsychotics have either null or negative effects on me,...
item.content:encoded:
upon review & correlation of data i have on my health/mental health, i think I may have a catecholamine deficiency.

i've realized that SSRI's & antipsychotics have either null or negative effects on me, Prozac/Zoloft/SSRI's in general had 0 effect or change on anything. some parts of antipsychotics helped me but mostly degraded me, for example, depakote's impulsivity control & latuda's focus.

while those don't work, i have noticed during self medication or past medical events that are unrelated, that I responded very well to stimulants themselves. Nicotine was a big one and helped me stay focused and on task. now that i'm sick, or recovering from sickness, one med I'm on being a stimulant, i've noticed time collapse & me being very focused on tasks and completing tasks in a short amount of time, and getting lost in music moreso.

low stimulants return me to a healthy baseline without executive dysfunction robbing me of life. to think that that state i get in on stimulants could actually be my healthy baseline and what im used to is actually so far below it... thats fucking insane. that means i have so much fucking potential that was robbed from me by a simple chemical imbalance !?

anyways, i hope to verify this soon! but i doubt it will cure my other issues that are from bpd/mdd/ptsd that have been lifelong especially the trauma-based things. however its a step in the right direction!

honestly i dont care if i still have to suffer the shadow figures/spiders/centipedes when stressed, or other things i spoke about here, i just want 2 things, my executive function returning in full & my amygdala to calm down and relax for once!

i wonder if i could get to a healthy baseline and then improve my overall cognition even further?? i mean at a healthy baseline, it has been proven in the past that i am at least in the top 12%, but if i can increase that?? oooh... that would be so cool. i do crave/lust for knowledge still, i just havent had the executive function to act or grow it in over a decade....

item.content:encoded:
i wish humanity would evolve as a whole.

i'm realizing i am different than others, but not in the ways that those others claim. i'm not evil, i'm not delusional, i'm not crazy nor schizo nor psychotic nor do i make things up.

i've noticed lately that i become the bad guy in many people's eyes when i finally set boundaries with them, after a long and hard battle of learning what they are for around 13 years. i've also noticed people try to bait me into emotional states as a game. people also spin narratives about private conversations to favor themselves. ecliques spin narratives to favor the tribe.

i only fit in with these people and other vile people my whole life because i allowed it, and yeah that is my own fault. but me going inward / putting on masks / being a chameleon around you =/= me being the sole architect of "evil" as some would claim.

i despise evil in all forms & view it as lower / ape brain-esque. thanks to my past, naturally. it's actually starting to get annoying to see this, and i suppose that's a good thing as it helps me take off the masks?

i wish my brain was coherent with this sort of articulation

but ive been demonized/ostracized for being different my whole life, so naturally, these thoughts hide from myself internally in favor of those who abused/bullied/etc me.

"you're 26, act your age"

and other lowly rhetoric meant to bring me down to your, unevolved level.

differences

i've noticed that my thinking patterns & vastness of my own mind does not really match those around me or those ive been friends with my entire life. as such, others have noticed that where i havent, and thought i was trying to be better than them or trying to put myself in competition, when im just existing & probably just processing my own trauma. but no, they had to add to it to satiate their own lowly ego.

i know some narcissists will get that grandiose "hero" archetype and be like "look! requiem is trying to be better!" fuck off. you are a detriment to myself and other humans alike. you are not the baseline nor ceiling of the human species.

the fact is, when i'm completely healthy, i am genuinely better than most. that is an objective fact given a 129iq when i was 9, and 145iq when i was 21, so my intellectual baseline is somewhere in between those numbers. but that is just the tip of the iceberg, even for me. i know my depth, yes, but i dont know how it relates to others, if its more or less as ive never had proper feedback or reinforcement for my own ego/mind/soul my whole life under the pretense of "acting better" than someone.

my mind is escaping me again, dammit. why cant these thoughts stay put! we're not going to get punished anymore!

Morality

I claim I am a good person, yes. but that is from my own observations & curated morality/ethics, and is not based on some sand-person book. nor do i care for status/fame/gaining favor over others, that effects me negatively. instead i get contentment and pleasure and joy from my own authenticity, or well trying to be authentic bc no stable self image.

my morality is simple: respect intelligence, and life as such, sovereign beings not below or above, but experiencing this reality together. this is actually something i learned from my occult practices.

what comes with that is Unconditional Kindness, Love, Respect to those that deserve it & are worthy. if any of my pattern recognition detects malice from you, then you will get the opposite of kindness/love/respect in response to your projection of malice. as such, many people have misread me as evil, but no, i'm either copying you or reflecting you.

also what comes with that is being nice to animals moreso than humans, they're innocent creatures & have no will! humans though, i'd have no remorse for killing rapists, murderers (cold blooded), pedophiles, and certain types of narcissists/emotional manipulators, as they do nothing but cause pain and is "anti" to my beliefs & "anti" to the laws of nature.

Fuck You.

if i cut you off, you're not a good person. it's that simple. ( that includes manipulating you and your group away from me & not knowing me, this can last weeks to years. )

item.content:encoded:
i again throw a few of my previous posts out as i contradict them in this one.

over the past few days of me being forced to go places, i have noticed hours later after post-processing the experiences, that ppl actually flirt with me and i just ignore them / i really don't have the social skills to handle it. i feel like a complete idiot 8 or so hours later, like always. but also why should that even bother me? i dont care for it, right?

even more to integrate i guess. and it shows that what i know about myself via meta-cognition & self-analysis, may be partially wrong, but wholly right. context matters though. see, i may know myself completely from the deep state i am in internally & project that to the outside as "me". sure that may be a more true me without the flesh. but that is the problem, no? i am flesh too.

maybe i need to bring that core to the surface and then re-examine myself entirely. maybe that will give me some important insights?

this also opens up alot of more avenues for me to explore & iterate upon, so that itself should be stimulating at least.

being human is genuinely weird. can i just be a machine already
